hashDefinitions.datasetHash: SHA-256 of stableStringify(all foods sorted by id) via computeFoodsDataHash
hashDefinitions.protectedFoodsDataHash: SHA-256 of stableStringify(full food objects for every non-pilot food, sorted by id) via computeFoodsDataHash
hashDefinitions.protectedFoodsNutritionHash: SHA-256 of stableStringify([{id, portion, nutrients}]) for every non-pilot food, sorted by id
